title: Collapse polled-flag API and migrate consumers to event-driven registry
creator: Aisha Patel
description: We have two legacy feature-flag surfaces still in use: a polled HTTP endpoint (/admin/flags/v0/poll) and a set of fallback route shims used by older control-plane agents. These surfaces increase maintenance surface area, bypass canonical route manifests, and cause subtle divergence in rollout history. This ticket collapses the polled API, migrates remaining consumers to the event-driven Flag Registry (webhook + streaming client), and removes the legacy route shims from the control-plane. The goal is to reduce runtime complexity, eliminate a class of stale rollout bugs, and simplify future flag auditing.
acceptance_criteria: All production callers of /admin/flags/v0/poll migrated to Flag Registry streaming or webhook within grace period
Polled endpoint returns 410 Gone behind a kill-flag and is removed from codebase in runtime-1.20 branch
Legacy route shims removed; config manifests validate against canonical schema with no compatibility layer enabled
No increase in 5xx errors or latency for flag evaluation paths after migration (SLOs maintained)
Migration runbook and audit logs published and linked from the console
migration_plan: Inventory: run a 2-week scan of service binaries and infra for polled endpoint usage (RPC logs + deploy metadata)
Contact owners: open direct Slack threads and tag owners for any discovered callers; schedule small migration windows
Adapter: ship a lightweight streaming client lib (flags-event-client v0.3) with backward-compatible API to ease consumer changes
Grace period: deploy a compatibility proxy that forwards polls to the streaming backplane while emitting deprecation warnings for one release cycle
Kill switch: enable feature gate to return 410 and start telemetry for remaining callers; decommission after 2 weeks of zero callers
rollout_plan: Canary: deploy compatibility proxy and streaming client to 5% of runtime fleet; monitor error/latency metrics for 48h
Broad rollout: increment to 50% then 100% in 24h steps if no regressions
Disable shims: flip config to remove route shims in control plane; monitor rollout graph for orphaned nodes
Final removal: merge code removal into mainline and cut runtime-1.20 with deprecation release notes
testing_notes: Unit tests for flags-event-client to validate delivered change notifications and back-pressure behavior
Integration tests that run a simulated polled client against compatibility proxy and streaming backplane
Load test: reproduce level of poll traffic (QPS) and validate that streaming backplane sustains throughput with <5% CPU delta
Chaos test: temporarily drop event stream and ensure fallback paths surface safe defaults and do not cause application crashes
